evidence: T-0042 covers Goal #30 P1.3.3 runtime registry / adapter contract only.

scripts/shiki_runtime_registry.py adds a standard-library-only RuntimeDescriptor registry with runtime name, display name, roles, execution mode, auth mode, required tools, required secrets, related workflows, capability flags, experimental/deprecated status, and description.
Known runtime inventory includes codex, codex-front, claude-code, claude-code-action, github-cca, github-actions, hermes-runner, human, and other.
scripts/shiki_contracts.py derives RUNTIME_NAMES from shiki_runtime_registry.runtime_names() to avoid independent runtime-name drift.

scripts/validate_shiki.py validates registry descriptor completeness, .shiki/config.yaml required runtime roles, unknown runtime names, unsupported role/runtime pairs, legacy other rationale, task assigned_runtime values, runtime docs coverage, and install/template inclusion.
scripts/shiki_runtime.py uses the registry for safe task runtime validation and deterministic doctor/status JSON output without implementing registry-driven dispatch.

scripts/test_shiki_runtime_registry.sh covers registry import, deterministic names, descriptor fields, get_runtime, unknown runtime rejection, role assignment validation, config fixture validation, task fixture validation, RUNTIME_NAMES drift, docs coverage, and staging inclusion.
scripts/test_shiki_module_boundaries.sh includes shiki_runtime_registry in import, staging, and install-target smoke coverage.

docs/agents/runtime-registry.md documents runtime identity vs runtime role, descriptor fields, supported runtimes, execution modes, auth modes, required tools/secrets, capability flags, and future adapter contract boundaries.

docs/agents/decision-control.md, docs/agents/checklists.md, and docs/agents/runtime-auth-model.md reference the registry without expanding into doctor, provider, migration, workflow, Guardian, CCA Review Bridge, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, P1.4, or P2 work.
summary: Recorded T-0042 runtime registry / adapter contract implementation evidence.
